description: Source file implementing debug record logging and file management for system monitoring tools, including initialization, signal handling, and writing logs to files.

methods.name: drInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the debug record system, sets up signal handlers, mutex, and opens log file.

methods.name: drClose
methods.description: Closes the log file, flushes remaining logs, and resets system state.

methods.name: drSignalHandler
methods.description: Handles signals like SIGSEGV and SIGTSTP to trigger log writing and default signal processing.

methods.name: drFilename
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the filename for log storage based on directory, postfix, and extension.

methods.name: drWrite
methods.description: Formats and appends log messages to internal buffer.

methods.name: drWriteToFile
methods.description: Flushes buffered logs to the log file.
